diffs.diff: header pin 3 (CS): part says nc, datasheet reading says io
diffs.evidence: The model is the I2C configuration of the MIKROE-2731 Click (interface i2c, buildNotes tell the user to move the COMM SEL jumpers to I2C); the vendor jumper table says 'Communication Interface Selection SPI/I2C, left' / 'position SPI, right position I2C', and JP2 switches the chip CS between the mikroBUS CS pin and VCC (CSX net in the schematic), so in I2C mode pin 3 (CS) is disconnected from the chip; the second reading described the factory SPI setting.
